THE LEARNING PATH

Where do we start? What comes next?

Nine classes are ready now, from birth to age two, in one calm sequence. Each class takes two to five playful minutes and is led by you. Age ranges are a guide, not a test — start where your child is and follow their cues.

Classrooms for older children

Beyond the early years, the school opens into hands-on classrooms: Art Studio, Science Lab, Nature Club, Maths Room, Story Corner and Build & Tinker, plus all activities by age.

Age ranges are a guide, not a test. Children learn at their own pace. Explore in any order that suits your family, and stop whenever your child has had enough.
